mostWorthwhile.text: Following the icy body through warming, fragmentation and the loss of much of its ice made its changing composition clear.

leastWorthwhile.text: The repeated break-and-reassemble sequence felt somewhat repetitive, especially with only one combination offered at each step.

surprise.text: The gently joined two-lobed body preserved a visible trace of its assembly, before a faster impact broke it apart.

arbitrary.text: The final meeting with the earlier small-body population felt less clearly motivated than the warming and impacts, though its low-speed outcome was explained.

continue.text: Yes, I would continue for another chapter: tracing material between distant and inner regions was interesting, though I would hope for more meaningful choices.
